name: LLM SIMP controller (Direct Numeric Control agent)

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The system prompt encodes domain knowledge in four parts
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed system prompt; per-call state goes in the user prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the solver state is serialized into a structured text prompt and submitted to the Gemini API
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the solver state vector is injected up front each call; there is no navigation and no file tree.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Each API call transmits≈500 input tokens (system prompt plus the serialized state observation)
context_compaction.note: Each call is stateless, so no history accumulates.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the solver state is serialized into a structured text prompt

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The model returns a JSON object with exact floating-point values for all four solver parameters plus a restart flag

tool_count.note: There are no tools; the single action is a JSON output.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The LLM outputs a single JSON object at each call

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: (i) a parameter description with physical bounds

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Everykth iteration (de-faultk= 5), the solver state is serialized into a structured text prompt
loop_primitives.note: Closest value: the solver loop invokes the LLM periodically as a controller. The meta-loop reflects across runs.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a four-stage advisory schedule (Table 1) that acts as a pacing hint

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a meta-optimization loop uses a second LLM pass to tune the agent’s call frequency and gate threshold across runs
multi_agent_topology.note: Coded as single; the meta-optimizer is an outer between-runs pass.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the inner agent adapts parameter values within a run; the outer loop adapts the agent’s own decision rules across runs

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The prompt is built from thirteen scalar quantities drawn from the state vector at each call

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: proposes updates to the primary agent’s own hyperparameters — grayness gate threshold, LLM call frequency, and phase timing constants — via regex patching of the source constants
long_term_memory.note: Closest value: cross-run adaptation is persisted by patching source constants.

self_verification.evidence_quote: All numeric outputs are clamped to the ranges in Table 2 by a deterministic safety layer before application.
self_verification.note: The safety clamps are guardrails, not verification of the work.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: When the Gemini API is unavailable or returns an invalid response, the agent falls back to a smooth deterministic ramp

rollback.note: The model can restart from the best valid density snapshot.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The inner loop executes the SIMP solver for up to Nmain-loop iterations

cost_controls.note: This is a per-call output cap only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: All numeric outputs are clamped to the ranges in Table 2 by a deterministic safety layer before application.
execution_isolation.note: Actions are only parameter values applied in-process to the solver.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The safety layer capsβ≤8.0wheneverG>0.20, regardless of what the LLM requests.
permission_model.note: The deterministic rule-based safety layer clamps actions.

tracing.evidence_quote: The DNC architecture produces a human-readable call log that can be reviewed post-hoc by the engineer

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: including the three-field SIMP solver, LLM agent, all baseline controllers, the meta-optimization loop scripts
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark comparison scripts are promised but the code is unreleased.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a large language model (LLM) acts as anonline adaptive controllerfor SIMP topology optimization
target_domain.note: The domain is scientific solver control.
